The absence of positive findings means alternatives (e.g., occult malignancy, subclinical hyperthyroidism, celiac disease, chronic infection) remain hypothetical and undifferentiated. - Persistent, non-paroxysmal fatigue is documented as a presenting concern.  
- Unintentional weight loss >5% over 1 month is explicitly quantified.

- Serum ferritin — required to assess iron stores; iron deficiency can cause fatigue independent of anemia.  
- 25-hydroxyvitamin D — deficiency is associated with fatigue and nonspecific systemic symptoms.

[DIAGNOSIS]  
Unexplained fatigue and weight loss
